title: Job Openings at Propetrol Limited
content:
Propetrol Limited is an energy trading company with a growing international footprint across marine fuels, gas, and refined petroleum products. We work with global oil companies, suppliers, trading houses, and shipping partners to move products efficiently across regional and international markets.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) Senior Associate, Bunker Trading

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	The Senior Associate, Bunker Trading will originate and execute bunker trading opportunities, develop client and supplier relationships, and contribute directly to trading volumes and profitability.
	Working under the Lead, International Bunker Trading, the successful candidate will manage assigned accounts and transactions, negotiate commercial terms within approved limits, and coordinate reliable delivery. Performance will be assessed against agreed volume, margin, client development, and execution targets.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and pursue profitable bunker trading opportunities across assigned markets.
	Develop and manage relationships with shipowners, vessel operators, brokers, suppliers, and trading partners.
	Obtain and assess supplier quotations, prepare competitive offers, and negotiate commercial terms within approved authority.
	Execute spot and term transactions in line with trading strategy and approved risk limits.
	Monitor bunker prices, vessel movements, supply availability, and market developments to inform trading decisions.
	Grow assigned accounts and develop new business to meet agreed volume and margin targets.
	Coordinate with suppliers, agents, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery against agreed specifications and terms.
	Review trade economics, including product costs, logistics charges, payment terms, and expected margins.
	Prepare and maintain accurate trade confirmations, contracts, delivery records, and transaction reports.
	Support counterparty screening and credit assessments, escalating exposures or exceptions before commitments are made.
	Work with Finance to monitor receivables, resolve invoice discrepancies, and support timely collections.
	Support the resolution of delivery issues, quantity or quality disputes, and commercial claims.
	Ensure transactions follow applicable regulations, sanctions requirements, and internal procedures.
	Provide regular updates on the sales pipeline, completed trades, margins, and market opportunities.


Qualifications & Experience


	Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Maritime Studies, Engineering, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of four years of relevant experience in bunker trading, marine fuel sales, oil trading, or commodities trading.
	Demonstrated experience originating or executing transactions and contributing to commercial targets.
	Strong understanding of bunker products, pricing, supply markets, and shipping logistics.
	Experience managing client and supplier relationships and negotiating commercial terms.
	Working knowledge of international trade documentation, counterparty risk, and credit controls.
	An established network within the bunkering or shipping industry is an advantage.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and trading or CRM systems.


Key Competencies:


	Strong commercial judgment and negotiation skills.
	Relationship building and business development.
	Market analysis and numerical accuracy.
	Risk awareness and disciplined execution.
	Ability to manage time-sensitive transactions across multiple stakeholders.
	Accountability, resilience, and professional integrity.


Salary
N1,000,000 - N1,500,000 per month. 

Application Closing Date; 29th November, 2026. 

Click here to apply online

 

2.) Senior Associate, Tax

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	The Senior Associate, Tax will support the delivery of Propetrol’s tax compliance, planning, and advisory activities across its business portfolios.
	The role requires a technically sound professional who can independently manage assigned tax workstreams, maintain accurate records, and provide practical analysis to support business decisions under the guidance of the Tax Lead.


Key Responsibilities


	Prepare tax computations, returns, and supporting schedules for review and timely filing.
	Track statutory filing and payment deadlines, escalating potential compliance gaps.
	Reconcile tax accounts with the general ledger and investigate discrepancies.
	Review transactions and documentation to ensure appropriate tax treatment.
	Support tax planning and assess the tax implications of contracts, investments, and business transactions.
	Research changes in tax legislation and prepare summaries of their business implications.
	Support tax audits and investigations by preparing documentation, responding to queries, and tracking outstanding issues.
	Liaise with tax authorities and external advisers as delegated by the Tax Lead.
	Support cross-border tax reviews, transfer pricing documentation, and related compliance activities where applicable.
	Maintain accurate tax records, audit trails, and evidence of filings and payments.
	Work with Finance, Legal, Procurement, and operational teams to resolve tax matters.
	Support improvements to tax processes and guide junior colleagues where required.


Qualifications & Experience


	Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.
	Relevant professional certification from ICAN, ACCA, or CITN is required.
	Minimum of four years of progressive experience in tax compliance, advisory, or corporate taxation.
	Experience in energy, oil and gas, commodities trading, or a professional services firm is preferred.
	Strong knowledge of Nigerian taxation and statutory compliance requirements.
	Working knowledge of international taxation and transfer pricing is an advantage.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting or ERP systems.


Key Competencies:


	Strong analytical and research skills.
	Accuracy and attention to detail.
	Effective communication and stakeholder management.
	Ability to manage multiple deadlines and work independently.
	Sound judgment, confidentiality, and professional integrity.


Salary
N300,000 - N1,000,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 30th November, 2026.

Click here to apply online

 

3.) Senior Associate, Business Development (EPC)

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	The Senior Associate, Business Development — EPC will originate and develop business opportunities, manage client relationships, and drive bids and proposals across Propetrol’s EPC portfolio.
	The successful candidate will independently manage assigned accounts and opportunities, working with technical and commercial teams to translate client requirements into competitive proposals.
	The role carries clear accountability for pipeline development, opportunity conversion, and contribution to agreed commercial targets.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify, qualify, and pursue EPC opportunities across oil and gas, marine, industrial infrastructure, and renewable energy markets.
	Develop account plans and manage assigned opportunities from initial engagement through negotiation, contract award, and handover.
	Research client investment plans, upcoming projects, market developments, and competitor activities.
	Build and grow relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and potential project partners.
	Lead client engagements, capability presentations, and proposal follow-up discussions for assigned accounts.
	Assess tender opportunities and provide recommendations for bid/no-bid decisions.
	Coordinate vendor registrations, prequalification submissions, and client procurement portal requirements.
	Drive proposal preparation with Engineering, Procurement, Operations, Finance, and Legal teams.
	Ensure bids address client requirements, reflect delivery capabilities, and meet submission deadlines.
	Support pricing reviews and assess commercial terms, delivery commitments, and potential risks with relevant teams.
	Support negotiations and resolve commercial clarifications within delegated authority.
	Identify partnership opportunities that strengthen technical capability and market access.
	Maintain accurate CRM records and provide pipeline forecasts, bid updates, and performance reports.
	Contribute to agreed targets for qualified opportunities, contract wins, revenue, and margins.
	Coordinate the handover of awarded contracts, ensuring scope, obligations, and commercial commitments are clearly documented.
	Represent Propetrol at industry events and support junior colleagues where required.
	Conduct all engagements in line with company approval procedures and ethical standards.


Qualifications & Experience


	Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of four years of relevant experience in business development, technical sales, tendering, or commercial roles.
	Relevant experience in EPC, engineering services, oil and gas, infrastructure, or renewable energy.
	Demonstrated track record of developing qualified opportunities and contributing to successful bids or contract wins.
	Strong understanding of EPC project lifecycles, tendering processes, and client procurement requirements.
	Experience managing client relationships and coordinating technical and commercial proposals.
	Ability to assess commercial opportunities and communicate the value of technical solutions.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools.
	An established industry network and relevant professional certification are advantages.


Key Competencies:


	Strong commercial judgment and opportunity development.
	Client relationship management and negotiation.
	Clear communication and persuasive presentation skills.
	Analytical thinking and attention to detail.
	Effective coordination across teams and deadlines.
	Initiative, accountability, and disciplined follow-through.
	Integrity and risk awareness.


Salary
N1,000,000 - N1,500,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 30th November, 2026.

Click here to apply online

Note: Candidates should submit their CV and Application through the designated application link above.
